principles: Every short must provide a complete standalone payoff before any next-video bridge.
Follow conversion and returning-viewer potential influence trend ranking but never weaken source, duplicate, quality or publishability gates.
Generic follow-for-more bait and empty cliffhangers are forbidden.
A paid promotion test may only be considered after observed post-publish performance; predicted scores alone never spend money.
Every paid test targets exactly 5 EUR total budget as requested, with an absolute 5 EUR cap; auction underdelivery is allowed but overspend is forbidden.
No more than two paid tests per week and 40 EUR per month may be started automatically.

hard_rules: Growth never weakens existing quality or publication gates.
A series episode is never selected merely because it is next.
Surface 4-5 strong candidates per editorial run; if fewer than four pass, rescan distinct angles without weakening any score or source rule.
Weak fill is forbidden: if two grounded scans still produce fewer than four strong candidates, fail closed instead of surfacing a thin list.
Raw views never replace engaged or qualified views silently.
Paid promotion may never exceed its configured per-test, weekly or monthly hard caps.
